notes.title: Patch Notes – TriMatch Update
notes.notes: [p][b]Patch Notes – TriMatch Update[/b][/p][p]Another small update with some quality-of-life improvements and fixes based on your feedback:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed issue with disappearing world rankings.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Top 3 Global Scores to the main menu – bragging rights now front and center![/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the time requirement on the "Speed Matcher" achievement to 35 seconds.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks for all your support – keep those high scores coming! 🔺🔥[/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes! TriMatch Bugfixes
notes.notes: [p][b]Patch Notes – TriMatch Update[/b][/p][p]We've been squashing some bugs and making small improvements to keep the triangle-matching action smooth and satisfying. Here's what's new in this update:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed issue where the tutorial popup blocked the pause dialog.[/p][/*][*][p]Lowered the initial sound volume.[/p][/*][*][p]Added ability to scroll to rotate tiles.[/p][/*][*][p]A few minor bug fixes and improvements.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks for playing and keep matching those triangles! 💛[/p]
